messages.subject: facet_grid and geom_text - does not work in combination
parts:
Hello,

I am not able to combine facet_grid and geom_text (that I use to label plotted data). And I do not understand the error message (see (7) and (8)).

I tried some plots. Number 7 and 8 do not work (white screen) though the motifs (in other combinations) work quite properly (see number 1 to 6).

(1) p <- ggplot (data=test) + geom_segment (aes (x=start.ens, xend=end.ens, yend=0, y=peak), color ="red")
(2) pt <- p + geom_text(aes (x=start.ens, xend=end.ens,yend=0, y=0, label = plabel, size=3))

(3) e <- ggplot (data=test) + geom_point (aes (x=start.ens, y=fc.trans))
(4) et <- e + geom_text(aes( x=start.ens, y=fc.trans, label=transcript.id, size=3))
(5) pe <- p+ geom_point (aes (x=start.ens, y=fc.trans))

(6) pef <- pe + facet_grid (type~., scales="free_y")

(7) peft <- pef + geom_text(aes (x=start.ens, xend=end.ens,yend=0, y=0, label = plabel, size=3))
> peft
Fehler in unit(x, default.units) : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0

(8)  petf <- pef +  geom_text(aes( x=start.ens, y=fc.trans, label=transcript.id, size=3))
> petf
Fehler in unit(x, default.units) : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0


Is there a way to combine facet_grid and geom_text (for my purpose)?

Thanks Hermann

messages.subject: Re: facet_grid and geom_text - does not work in combination
parts:
It seems as though geom_text does not work with facet_grid in situations when all labels are NA in at least one facet. A workaround is to assign empty text instead of NA:

test$plabel[1:2] = ""

Afterwards the error disappears.

Better late than never :)
